item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat TASK.md && cat solution.py && cat test_public.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3.12 -c 'from solution import patch_query
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qsl
cases = [
 (\"/p?a=1&b=&a=2&flag#f\", [], [(\"a\",\"1\"),(\"b\",\"\"),(\"a\",\"2\"),(\"flag\",\"\")]),
 (\"/p?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4\", [(\"a\",\"x\"),(\"b\",None),(\"a\",\"\")], [(\"c\",\"4\"),(\"a\",\"\")]),
 (\"?A=1&a=2&%61=3&x+y=4&x%2By=5\", [(\"a\",None),(\"x y\",\"v\")], [(\"A\",\"1\"),(\"x+y\",\"5\"),(\"x y\",\"v\")]),
 (\"https://user:pw@EXAMPLE.invalid:443/a%2Fb?x=1#f%20g\", [(\"雪 +%&=\",\"é +%&=\")], [(\"x\",\"1\"),(\"雪 +%&=\",\"é +%&=\")]),
 (\"../rel?=one&=two&a=\", [(\"\",None),(\"z\",\"\")], [(\"a\",\"\"),(\"z\",\"\")]),
 (\"//EXAMPLE.invalid/p?x=1#frag\", [(\"missing\",None)], [(\"x\",\"1\")]),
 (\"mailto:user@example.invalid?subject=old\", [(\"subject\",\"hello+world & 100%\")], [(\"subject\",\"hello+world & 100%\")]),
]
for url, updates, expected in cases:
    before = list(updates)
    result = patch_query(url, updates)
    assert updates == before
    assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(result).query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, result
    old, new = urlsplit(url), urlsplit(result)
    assert (old.scheme,old.netloc,old.path,old.fragment) == (new.scheme,new.netloc,new.path,new.fragment)
    assert patch_query(url, (pair for pair in updates)) == result
print(f\"{len(cases)} edge cases passed with list preservation, generator, and component checks\")'"
